bio.text: Craig Lipscomb (listed by Ballotpedia as B. Craig Lipscomb), a Republican, has represented District 30 in the Alabama House of Representatives since taking office on November 7, 2018, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot for re-election.
Lipscomb graduated from Coosa Christian High School in 1994, spent two years at Gadsden State Community College, and graduated from Auburn University with a bachelor of architecture degree.
He worked at an architecture firm in his hometown and served as a general contractor for two years.
